english: Is this St. Mont Blanc Academy\nclose to here?
We'll get there in half a day.
Hmm, we'll probably\nmake it there today?
I hope we get to meet the teacher.
Yes…
What's wrong? You're looking down.
…I was wondering\nhow [NOEL]'s doing.
She stormed out of Dokoka Town,\nand there's been no word since.
Yes… she's probably still searching for the teacher,\nwandering around somewhere alone.
And there's no way to check if she's safe.\nNo sign she ever stopped by Dokoka Town?
None… that's what worries me most.
Whichever world she went to,\nthere's a good chance she'd stop by Dokoka Town.
[NOEL]…\nsheeesh, where'd you go…
[MERU],\nwhere'd you go, I wonder…
So [MERU] is the partner\nwho set out with you to find the teacher,\nthen disappeared along the way, right?
After a fight, she stormed out of Dokoka Town,\nand there's been no word since.
She's cautious, so unless something really bad happened\nI don't think she'd do anything reckless, but…\nthe way she left was…
And there's no way to check if she's safe.\nNo sign she ever stopped by Dokoka Town?
That's the mystery. [MERU] never showing up\nin Dokoka Town even once-\ngiven how she's acted before, that's impossible.
Maybe, in some world…!
No use imagining the worst.\nThey say no news is good news, right?
Yeah… thanks, Suzu.
//Fade to black\n//Background: seaside (a riverbank or something)
One more, please!
Get into stance, quick.\nOn the battlefield, bullets fly before greetings.\nAlways be ready to guard and dodge.
Yes!
I don't really know what this 'strength'\nyou're after is,\nbut I can tell you this much.
If you train with me,\nyou'll definitely get stronger.
I think so too! Haaah!!
Faster! What takes you 1 second, cut to 0.5!\nYou can do it, Hibiki!
Ooooh!!
//SE: sharp sounds of Aria and Hibiki sparring
Tachibana's working hard.
Those two always devote themselves to training.\nAdmirable spirit.
Kanzaki, handling Tachibana's persistence so calmly,\nis splendid too.\nMaybe I'll review my sword forms as well.
Even a master like you\nsometimes loses your way with the blade?
I am a guardian charged with protecting humanity.\nEven this body, tempered like a sword, is still unripe.\nOf course I still lose my way.
No matter the sword,\nneglect its polish and it rusts and dulls.\nAnd no sword is ever complete… don't you think?
//Tsubasa leaves.
(No sword is ever complete… I…)
Ah, Houki! Got a sec?
Hm? Done training with Aria?
Yeah. Aria said I should learn\nwhat strength is from all kinds of people.\nSo I thought I'd ask you to teach me too, Houki.
Me, teach Hibiki?
You're the best kendo practitioner in Japan, right?\nFor someone who's reached the pinnacle of martial arts,\nwhat is strength?
Hmm… For me, strength is\n'mastering power'… I think.
What is it?
That's it! Tell me more about that, please!
I don't mind… but there are stronger people than me.\nIs my story really what you want…?
I want to hear YOUR story, Houki!\nWhat does 'mastering power' mean?
It's a long story, though…
//Fade to black\n//Background: plains (day)
I steered Hibiki toward Houki-\nwas that okay?
Yes, I think it went well.
You really love fussing over Hibiki, huh.
That's part of it, but not all.\nTachibana has power… dangerously great power.\nWhat worries me is that she's losing control of it.
I heard from Hibiki. She's afraid of her power running wild.\nShe's training to overcome that, right?
A Symphogear's power isn't just physical-\nit's also a manifestation of the heart.
That's surely not something that can be taught-\nit's something she has to realize herself.
So you figured she could learn something from Houki?
To me, those two seem to share\nsimilar problems.\nBy facing each other, they should see something.
Like facing mirrors?
Gazing at what each other lacks,\nwhile noticing each other's strengths too.\nWhether it'll work, I don't know.
Hmm. Why don't you become a teacher or something?
…If I had that kind of dexterity,\nmaybe I wouldn't have chosen\nthe life of a guardian.
//Fade to black\n//Background: seaside (a riverbank or something)
In other words, martial arts are not violence for hurting others.\nUnless you hold that in your heart,\nmind, technique, and body can never be perfected. That is what I believe.
So that's what 'mastering power' means?
No one taught me that, exactly.\nIt's just what I've come to think from my own experience.\nAs for confidence… I have none.
But somehow, I feel clearer now!\nGetting stronger is scary, isn't it.\nBut with heart, it's not scary!
To be honest, that's what I want to believe.
(I once made the mistake of lashing out\nwith impulsive violence.\nThis time, can I win without mistaking what strength is…)
…I understand. I've also been tossed around by power,\nand turned it in the wrong direction.
You too…?
But hearing your story, Houki,\nI feel like I grasped something!\nI can't explain it well, though…
It's a difficult thing.
It really is.
//Soniko comes over.
D-difficult~!
Whoa!? Soniko!?
What's with the sudden outburst!? You startled me!
Ah! I-I'm sorry…! Actually, I was hoping\nI could help out in the action scenes too,\nso, um, I was practicing, but…
(It'd be better if Soniko stayed in the back…)
(If I teach her something half-baked and she gets cocky\nand charges to the front, that's a problem)
It's d-difficult… uuuh… um, excuse me!\nIf it's not too much trouble, could you teach me\nsome tricks or something…!
(Ah, I have a good idea!)
Got it! I'll teach Soniko\nmy secret special technique!
Wah! Really!?\nThank you so much!
Practice hard, okay!\nFirst, take a half-body stance like this…
Mhm mhm…!
(Is this going to be okay…?)
Um, this way is right.\nUfufu, I wanna see the teacher soon.
//[NOEL] appears
Ah!! [NOEL]!!
Where have you been all this time!?\nI've been looking for you this whole tiiiime, you know?
That's right! The teacher might be back\nat St. Mont Blanc Academy!!\nWe can finally meet…
That's got nothing to do with me.
Huh…?
Forget that, there's something more important.\nYou and me-let's settle which of us is better.
Wh-what are you saying?\nThe teacher's been found and you call it 'that'!?\nWhat's gotten into you!?
So? Something wrong with that?
It's all wrong!!\nWhy bring up 'who's better' now,\nwhen we can finally see the teacher!?
Even for you, [NOEL],\nwhat you're saying is way too crazy!!
We've always known.\nThat we just don't think alike.\nRight?
Even so, even so…!!
Time to end the arguing.\nTaste my Magical Magic!
//Battle start\n//Ally reinforcements deploy on turn 2, then enemy reinforcements
Huh? Isn't that [NOEL]?
Wah~! Long time no see!\nYou look well-that's wonderful!
[NOEL]! We finally met!
Are you unhurt, [NOEL]?
I heard you'd gone missing,\nbut you're back.
[NOEL], welcome back!
I've got business with [MERU].\n…Move… you're in the way.
//Grunt enemies appear
This can't… be…?\nNo way, this…!
Imagine whatever you like.\nAs long as I settle who's better-\nme or [MERU]-that's enough for me.
[NOEL]!!\nYou're making me mad!!!
//Event on defeating [NOEL]
How… losing to [MERU] of all people!
You can say or do whatever you want to me.\nBut… but, if the teacher found out about this,\nshe'd be sad, wouldn't she?
I told you, the teacher's got nothing to do with it.
[NOEL]!!
Hmph! Let's call this one a draw.\nNext time won't go like this!
//[NOEL] vanishes with the light.
[NOEL]!? What was that…!!
That was… how the enemies do it, right?
[NOEL]…
//Battle end
[MERU]…
We finally met again…\nI was going to apologize, and now this…
Without knowing what happened to [NOEL],\nwe don't know what to do, do we.
I think it's too early to assume\nshe's defected to the enemy.
Tsubasa…
The human heart isn't as strong as steel.\nIt breaks and bends\nfar more easily.
B-but… that girl…?
What if I told you I once turned\nmy blade on Tachibana and attacked her?
You attacked Hibiki…!?
It's true, [MERU].\nThere was a time when my heart and Tsubasa's\nwere that far apart.
But people can truly\nreach each other's hearts.\nRight, Tachibana?
Yes!\nBecause people can talk to each other!
Hibiki… Tsubasa…
Got it! I won't let this get me down!\nWe'll be good friends again, just like before…!
That's the spirit!\nFirst, let's go to St. Mont Blanc Academy\nand meet the teacher.
Yes! The teacher will surely\nlend us her wisdom!
Almost to St. Mont Blanc Academy?\nHehe, maybe I'll run on ahead!
//[MERU] appears
Huh? [MERU]!?
Don't just pop up outta nowhere!!\nGlad you're looking okay, though.
Oh, did you know?\nThe teacher might be at St. Mont Blanc Academy!\nWe can finally meet…
…I don't care.
Hunya…?
I came to settle this.\nYou and me-we're deciding who's better.
Wh-… why now!?\nForget that, let's go see the teacher together!
No!!!
What is WITH you!?
Do you even hear yourself?\nDo you have a fever or something!?
I've always known you and I\njust don't think alike.\nNo point making a fuss about it now.
That's crazy!! That's not like you!\nThat's not you at all!
No discussion! I'm just gonna treat you\nto my sure-kill magical yo-yo!
//Battle start\n//Ally reinforcements deploy on turn 2, then enemy reinforcements
Huh? Isn't that [MERU]?
[MERU]!! It's me!!
So you were here…
[MERU], welcome back!
I've got no business with anyone but [NOEL].\n…Don't get in my way.
//Grunt enemies appear
Wh-what… is this…?
Figure it out yourself.\nWell, with YOUR noggin, it's hopeless anyway.
Geez!! What is WITH you!!
//Event on defeating [MERU]
I'll give you this much… well done…
Doing stuff like this,\nthe teacher's gonna scold you!
The teacher's got nothing to do with it!\nThis is between you and me!
[MERU]!!
Next time won't go like this…
//[MERU] vanishes with the light.
[MERU]!? What was that…!!
That's… how the enemies travel… right?
[MERU]…
//Battle end
[NOEL]…
The next time I saw [MERU]…\nI was going to… apologize.\nBut… why…!
Without knowing what happened to [MERU],\nwe don't know what to do, do we.
I think it's too early to assume\nshe's defected to the enemy.
Tsubasa…
The human heart isn't as strong as steel.\nIt breaks and bends\nfar more easily.
You think so?
What if I told you I once turned\nmy blade on Tachibana and attacked her?
Eeeeeh!? No way, that can't be!
It's true, [NOEL].\nThere was a time when my heart and Tsubasa's\nwere that far apart.
But people can truly\nreach each other's hearts.\nRight, Tachibana?
Yes!\nBecause people can talk to each other!
Words… I see.
Yeah, you're right!\n[MERU]'s smart, so\nif we talk it out properly, it'll be okay!
That's the spirit!\nFirst, let's go to St. Mont Blanc Academy\nand meet the teacher.
Yeah! I'll ask the teacher for advice too!
//Fade to black\n//Background: plains\n//Everyone training
Hibiki! Move faster!
Yes!
Shinonono, don't let your footwork falter.\nIt's a battle of endurance.
I know!
Hah!
Naive!
//SE: sharp sounds of combat
Honestly, I'm surprised.\nHouki wanting to spar with Hibiki.
That just shows how close\nthey've become, don't you think?
Power…!
Master it!!
//SE: sharp sounds of combat\n//Fade to black - time passes
Whew, that nice tired-and-sore feeling!
Even with protective gear, to take my strikes\nand still be standing…
Aria's brutal training\nwas way more intense!
I only put her through it\nbecause I know how much she can take.
How's training without your Symphogear and IS?
It's a different thing.
Different, yet the same.
Ahaha, I get it!
At this rate, we could do a two-person cell\nmock battle soon.
When that time comes, I'll…
//Soniko comes over.
Um, excuse me! Could you let me join in too!?
Soniko?
S-since Hibiki was kind enough to teach me\na technique…!\n…Uuuh, toryaa!
//Event art: Soniko masters the cat-fist pose
…U-unyaaan!
N-nyaa~n! U-unya!
(Hibiki, what is this?)
(I figured something safe for Soniko)
I-it's embarrassing…! But if this means\nI can be of use to everyone…!
This stance is for intercepting-\na technique to counterattack swiftly when attacked!
Nyaa~n! Shpa, shpapa!
And it's cute too!\nPerfect for an idol like Soniko!
Toryaa! Nyaa~n!
(Hibiki, your imagination is genius…)
//Event art off\n//Fade to black\n//Background: forest (day)
Fuu…
Good work~.
Doesn't watching me do focus training\nbore you?
We're both priestesses, but you're different from me,\nand that's interesting.
Seika priestesses use the demon arts\npassed down through generations.\nThat training is essential.
Shirayuki's a hard worker.
What do you do, Rika?
I do mochi-pounding~.
Mochi-pounding?
I practiced so I could wield\na heavy hoe in the rites.
Then you're super strong.
You use a sword, Shirayuki,\nso you're super strong too.
Swords aren't that heavy.\nMachine guns weigh like ten times more.
Eh.
Ufufu, being a priestess is all about arm strength.
N-nipah~☆
But I'm glad.\nThat you're here, Rika the priestess.
Are normal people hard for you, Shirayuki?
…So you have it too, Rika.\nThat feeling of not being normal.
I…
I can tell.\nWatching you and Satoko,\nI can tell you're different.
Mii…
But I envy you, Rika.\nBeing able to connect with people like that.
Yes it is. Nipah~☆
(Yes, it's a very happy thing,\nwhich is why I want to protect Satoko and the others… but\nI'm far too powerless…)
Rika, if anything's troubling you,\ntell me anytime, okay?
Shirayuki?
Because maybe there are things\nonly I would understand.
…If I'm wrong about that, I'm sorry.
No, thank you.
(Yes, Shirayuki surely has something\nshe hasn't shown yet…\njust like me)
//Fade to black\n//Background: in front of St. Mont Blanc Academy (night if available)\n//Teacher, in silhouette.
That takes care of this side.\nNow then, next is…
//Teacher leaves.\n//END
